sections.heading: Role Summary
sections.body: Software Engineer at Vantage Circle from February 2021 to May 2024 in Guwahati, India. Built enterprise HR-tech products used by global clients.

sections.heading: Responsibilities
sections.body: Developed frontend and backend systems for feedback, survey, milestone, and rewards products. Worked with React, Angular, TypeScript, NgRx, RxJS, Spring Boot microservices, and REST APIs.

sections.heading: Key Achievements
sections.body: Built products used by 500+ global clients and Fortune 500 organizations. Created CRO tools that increased lead conversion by 50%. Migrated a Ghost blog to Gatsby and improved PageSpeed from 70 to 90. Automated CI/CD with GitHub Actions and Gulp.
